name: Xbox Series X|S Controller (Bluetooth)
notes: 262-byte XboxGIP descriptor from DsHidMini, extended from 10 to 12 buttons so the Share button lands at descriptor button 12 (padding 6 bits to 4, 16-bit envelope unchanged). nativeDescriptor preserves the original 10-button DsHidMini GIP. Guide via System Main Menu, Share via buttonMap. productString is the name the pad gives over Bluetooth (SDL test/testevdev.c, the model 1914 entry via Bluetooth), and deviceDescription the name Windows gives its HID child, which Windows.Gaming.Input reads. The device version is 0523 on both backends, the revision a real pad's Bluetooth node carries in its hardware IDs. On the USB/IP backend the profile presents bluetoothHid: a USB HID device with this profile's VID, PID and version, and the 283-byte descriptor the pad sends over Bluetooth (DsHidMini docs/XINPUTHID.md). Its buttonMap places the buttons where xinputhid reads them for this PID: A 1, B 2, X 4, Y 5, LB 7, RB 8, View 11, Menu 12, Xbox 13, LS 14, RS 15, with Share on Consumer Record. xinputhid is an upper filter on the device, as xinputhid.inf places it on a real pad's Bluetooth node, and the HID child HID\VID_045E&PID_0B13&IG_00 carries the XUSB interface. The device's first compatible ID is a BTHLEDevice marker, which SDL's hidapi reads as the Bluetooth bus, and Windows.Gaming.Input reads IsWireless true.
